{{Top|leg}}
The '''MC Utility Sub''' was a twelve-[[Meter/Legends|meters]]-long craft, built by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], and used in the construction of their floating [[City/Legends|cities]]. Each vehicle included a cutting [[Laser/Legends|laser]] and four clawed arms for deploying probes or collecting samples.
